apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged once per run (Apify synthetic start event; priced per GB of run memory, 1 GB minimum). Target ~$0.001 for a typical 256 MB–1 GB start.

opportunity-notice.eventDescription: Charged once per SUCCESSFUL SAM.gov opportunity notice card (search or noticeId lookup returned a notice, Markdown card written). Includes title, agency, NAICS, dates, award/value if present, uiLink, description excerpt, and inclusion in REPORT.md. Failures (missing/invalid key → 404, not found, rate limit after retries, 5xx, empty search) are free.
